title: Bind published ports to loopback - no authentication exists and six ports are published on 0.0.0.0
impact: Unauthenticated read of all conversations and copied production Salesforce data, plus free GPU use, from any host on the network

title: Fix sql_guard escape-string desynchronisation that defeats the multi-statement check
impact: Guard's core promise (exactly one SELECT) is false; confirmed bypass, not currently exploitable only because DuckDB is opened read_only with external access disabled

title: Stop storing every Salesforce value as VARCHAR - rankings and aggregates are silently wrong
impact: ORDER BY Amount returns the wrong rows and MAX returns the wrong record; SUM fails outright. Wrong analytics answers presented confidently

title: Off-load the blocking DuckDB query off the event loop
impact: One slow query freezes every concurrent user's SSE stream and stalls /health

title: Fail closed on the conversation-ownership check
impact: A transient DB error silently disables the IDOR guard; the code comment claims the opposite behaviour

title: Close the SSRF resolve-then-connect window (sequential DNS rebinding)
impact: A pasted link can be redirected to 127.0.0.1:8080 or any internal service after passing the guard

title: Bound the /chat request body
impact: Unauthenticated remote OOM; no size limit on messages, image or pdf fields

title: Add CI - 1141 passing tests are only ever run by hand
impact: No automated gate; regressions reach main unnoticed despite a suite that runs in under a minute

title: Delete the plaintext credential backup .env.bak-205921
impact: Salesforce and Hugging Face credentials in cleartext on disk; untracked by git but exposed to host and backup access

title: Fence untrusted web/URL/repo/document text before it enters the model prompt
impact: Prompt injection via attacker-controlled page content with no instruction-stripping or provenance tainting

title: Remove dead AWS Secrets Manager config from .env.example
impact: Solicits real AWS credentials for a feature deleted on 2026-07-28; zero references anywhere in code or compose

title: Add an object/field allowlist to guard_soql
impact: Model-authored SOQL can read any object the integration user can see; bounded by that user being read-only

title: Stream and cap fetch bodies instead of buffering the whole response
impact: max_bytes is applied after the full body is already in memory

title: Run the schema script and migrate() once at startup rather than on all 32 connect() call sites
impact: Every DB operation re-executes 13 CREATE TABLE statements and 2 PRAGMA queries

title: Reuse one AsyncOpenAI client per base URL instead of constructing and leaking one per call
impact: Connection churn and unclosed httpx clients on every LLM call

title: Add a text-only PDF path - extraction rasterises up to 10 pages and discards the images
impact: Wasted CPU and memory on every PDF URL fetched

title: Apply the references_a_known_table hallucination guard on the SQL retry path too
impact: The retry can execute invented SQL that the first attempt would have been refused for

title: Create a unique index on Id for every warehouse object table
impact: Each sync batch full-scans the table on DELETE ... WHERE Id IN (...)

title: Add foreign keys or explicit cleanup for uploads url_documents repos and repo_chunks
impact: Deleting a conversation orphans its uploads, fetched pages and indexed source code permanently

title: Add a restart policy and healthcheck to sync-worker
impact: If the worker exits the warehouse silently stops refreshing and /health still reports ok

title: Log every swallowed exception - 42 broad except Exception handlers degrade silently
impact: Failures are invisible; a lost assistant answer is discarded with no record

title: Propagate a correlation id from browser through orchestrator engine and model
impact: No way to trace one request across the stack when debugging a slow or wrong answer

title: Pin orchestrator dependencies and commit a lockfile
impact: Builds are not reproducible; all deps float on unbounded >= with no lock, unlike sync-worker and frontend

title: Add end-to-end coverage for the 8 critical paths
impact: All 1141 tests are unit-level; no test exercises a full request through the real SSE contract

title: Remove the published vLLM host ports to stop unmetered GPU consumption
impact: Anyone on the network can submit 262k-token prompts against the shared KV pool

title: Document MOCK_MODE or gate it to development builds
impact: An undocumented env var silently serves fabricated fixture answers with no visual indication

title: Introduce a real engine Protocol - the Emit alias is re-declared in three files
impact: No runtime or type guarantee that an engine honours the contract

title: Remove the dead is_safe_select helper
impact: Defined and tested but never called by application code

title: Split the two god-files db.py (1064 LOC) and ChatApp.tsx (916 LOC)
impact: Both concentrate many responsibilities and are the hardest files to change safely

title: Correct the archive.py docstring - the zip-slip check is not re-run at write time
impact: Docstring overstates the guarantee; practical risk is low because symlinks are never extracted

title: Fix NO_DATA_MESSAGE which tells users to add AWS credentials for a removed feature
impact: User-facing instruction references infrastructure that no longer exists

title: Sanitise the terminal SSE error event - raw exception text is sent to the browser
impact: str(exc) is published verbatim as the error message, leaking internal file paths, generated SQL, DuckDB errors and Salesforce API detail to the client

title: Add per-call timeouts to the router fallback chain
impact: Both router calls inherit LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=300s and both swallow exceptions, so a wedged classifier can burn up to 600s (plus decide()'s own 300s) with no user feedback before defaulting to rag

title: Add a non-root USER to the orchestrator image
impact: The orchestrator is the only app container with no USER directive - it runs as root while holding /data read-write (Salesforce JWT key) and executing LLM-generated SQL; sync-worker uses USER worker and frontend USER nextjs

title: Add python-multipart to requirements-dev.txt
impact: main.py:23 imports .uploads whose File()/Form() decorators raise RuntimeError at import time without it; on a clean host the whole orchestrator suite fails at collection. Latent only because this machine happens to have it installed

title: Remove or wire up the .env.example variables that reach no container
impact: There is no env_file: anywhere in compose (0 matches), so only explicitly interpolated ${VAR} values reach a container. 18 of 43 documented variables - including every context-management threshold and CHART_TRIGGER_MODE - are silent no-ops when set

title: Replace four tests that cannot fail
impact: test_search_off.py:29 ends assert True; test_search_engine.py:115 asserts a bool is in (True, False); test_chart_pipeline.py:199 asserts x is None or True; test_conversation_integrity.py:553-566 monkeypatches the checker to itself - all pass unconditionally

title: Fix the SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS value documented in README
impact: README documents 10; .env.example:55 and config.py:197 both say 100
